import subprocess, sys, time, json
def t(name, payload):
    t0 = time.time()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "/workspace/submission/main.py"], input=payload, capture_output=True)
    el = time.time()-t0
    out = p.stdout.decode().splitlines()
    print("%-28s %6.2fs rc=%d lines=%d first=%s" % (name, el, p.returncode, len(out), out[0][:60] if out else ""))
# 1MB of open brackets
t("1MB brackets", b"[" * 1048576 + b"\n")
# 1MB of balanced brackets (depth 0/1 alternating)
t("1MB [] pairs", b"[]" * 524288 + b"\n")
# 1MB alternating quote/backslash (all inside one string)
t("1MB quotes+backslash", b'{"services":["' + b'\\"' * 524200 + b'"]}\n')
# 1MB of string content (letters)
t("1MB string", b'{"services":["' + b"a" * 1048500 + b'"]}\n')
# 4 lines of 1MB
t("4x1MB brackets", (b"[" * 1048576 + b"\n") * 4)
# many keys object
t("100k keys", b"{" + b",".join(b'"k%d":%d' % (i, i) for i in range(100000)) + b"}\n")
# big array of numbers
t("200k ints", b"[" + b",".join(str(i).encode() for i in range(200000)) + b"]\n")
# deep but valid nesting at limit (60 nots) repeated with 1MB padding
base = json.dumps({"services": [], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "true"}}], "queries": []}).encode()
t("valid + spaces to 1MB", base + b" " * (1048576 - len(base)) + b"\n")
# max queries: 256 queries x 4096 tokens = 1M tokens (limit is 16384 total, so this is E_LIMIT)
q = {"services": ["a"], "rules": [], "queries": [["a"] * 4096] * 4 + [["a"]]}
t("16385 tokens", (json.dumps(q) + "\n").encode())
q2 = {"services": ["a"], "rules": [], "queries": [["a"] * 4096] * 4}
t("16384 tokens ok", (json.dumps(q2) + "\n").encode())
EOF
